title: hypobathrum longifolium var. hirta

It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Hypobathrum longifolium var. hirta include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
